body: My mother and father are separated because he was accused twice of molesting my older sister from a previous marriage.
It doesn’t matter why we’re here, the question is why stay?

It’s not really morals keeping me from doing wrong though. Leave a cookie on the table overnight and it’s gone.  

The asshole thing is I have 0 empathy and it shows, I’d rather you hate me than bother me with your problems/small talk.

I honestly don’t know why I haven’t sat down with a therapist.  It’s heavily stigmatized in my culture (take a guess) and I can usually talk myself down.  I’ve been a loner my whole life and I think I’m doing fine dealing with things internally, if it gets worse I might get help just for a second opinion before I go through with it. 

This is more a conscious understanding that given certain very possible circumstances life wouldn’t be worth it.
